text: In the days of Noah, a double curse was resting upon the earth, and consequence of Adam's transgression, and of the murder committed by Cain.
The human race, yet retained much of its early vigor, but a few generations had passed since Adam had access to the tree.
In the green fields and under the shadow of the goodly trees, they set up the altars of their idols.
Extensive groves that retained their foliage throughout the year.
